notes.title: PO'ed: Definitive Edition has been updated!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957224/1b0040118c7d064643bb6f324db11b00aff4bd06.png[/img]

PO’ed: Definitive Edition has been updated across all platforms! Here are some of the bug fixes and improvements included in the patch:

[list]
[*] New door texture in Shuttle level, making it easier to identify what is a door and what is not.
[*] Fix the double bind issue in default configuration.
[*] Fix Speedrunner achievement, which did not account for hours (only minutes).
[*] Fix Fully Stocked achievement.
[*] New quality-of-life option "Auto-level Missile Cam".
[*] Lost media added to /Vault in KPF.
[*] Fix crash involving saves and blobs.
[*] Pass-through wall in Sponge is now transparent.
[/list]

notes.title: В осаде и с подливой: Обзор PO'ed: Definitive Edition
notes.notes: В последний раз я слышал про PO’ed 25 лет назад, когда раздобыл к своей FZ-10 книжку "50 лучших игр для 3DO". Тот факт, что она попала в список, очень плохо характеризует провальную консоль от основателя EA Трипа Хокинса в плане доступных на ней проектов и очень хорошо в том смысле, что она явно пользовалась определенным спросом в России.

notes.title: Nightdive Studios are bringing back 90’s shooter PO’ed in all its frying-pan wielding glory
notes.notes:
It’s usually better when writing about games to defer to personal experience before regurgitating marketing, but in the case of bizarre and deeply intriguing 90’s FPS PO’ed, the trailer that STAR WARS: Dark Forces Remaster studio Nightdive released over the long weekend contains a quote that sums up my memories perfectly: “First game I ever owned and played on my PS1,” says quote-ee matt.baller, “In hindsight, I’m surprised I’m not more messed up.”

PO’ed, in which you play a Pissed Off space chef crash-landed on an alien world, was not the very first game I owned for my PS1, but it was certainly one of, and it left a very strong impression. Probably because the first weapon you get is a frying pan, which you then use to batter horrible chicken-leg aliens. If you’re as lost as I imagine anyone hearing of this for the first time might rightly be, here’s that trailer.
